parameters.zh: 湿表面积 S=0 时使用 Holtrop 公式估算；AT 为艉封板浸水面积，ABT 为艏垂线处球鼻艏浸水横剖面面积，hb 为其形心距基线高度。
parameters.en: S=0 requests the Holtrop wetted-area estimate. AT is immersed transom area; ABT is immersed bulb cross-sectional area at the forward perpendicular; hb is its centroid height above baseline.

sources.zh: Holtrop & Mennen, An Approximate Power Prediction Method, International Shipbuilding Progress 29(335), 1982；Holtrop, A Statistical Reanalysis of Resistance and Propulsion Data, 31(363), 1984.
sources.en: Holtrop & Mennen, An Approximate Power Prediction Method, International Shipbuilding Progress 29(335), 1982; Holtrop, A Statistical Reanalysis of Resistance and Propulsion Data, 31(363), 1984.

parameters.zh: SLOA：总长；B：船宽；AL：侧向受风投影面积；AS：上层建筑侧向投影面积；AT：横向受风投影面积。
parameters.en: SLOA: overall length; B: beam; AL: lateral projected wind area; AS: lateral projected superstructure area; AT: transverse projected wind area.

parameters.zh: S 为侧向投影周长，不含水线及细长构件；C 为船首至侧向投影形心的距离。
parameters.en: S is the perimeter of the lateral projection, excluding the waterline and slender bodies; C is the distance from the bow to its centroid.

parameters.zh: M：独立的桅杆或起货柱组数。
parameters.en: M: Number of distinct groups of masts or kingposts.

results.zh: $C_x=\frac{F_x}{\frac{1}{2}\rho_a V_r^2 A_T}$；$C_y=\frac{F_y}{\frac{1}{2}\rho_a V_r^2 A_T}$；$C_{mz}=\frac{M_z}{\frac{1}{2}\rho_a V_r^2 A_T L_{OA}}$。
results.en: $C_x=\frac{F_x}{\frac{1}{2}\rho_a V_r^2 A_T}$; $C_y=\frac{F_y}{\frac{1}{2}\rho_a V_r^2 A_T}$; $C_{mz}=\frac{M_z}{\frac{1}{2}\rho_a V_r^2 A_T L_{OA}}$.

sources.zh: R. M. Isherwood, Wind Resistance of Merchant Ships, Proceedings of the Royal Institution of Naval Architects, 1973。
sources.en: R. M. Isherwood, Wind Resistance of Merchant Ships, Proceedings of the Royal Institution of Naval Architects, 1973.

limits.zh: 线性评估的浅水修正适用于 $\frac{H}{T}\geq 1.3$。回转预估采用深水模型。
limits.en: The shallow-water correction for linear evaluation applies at $\frac{H}{T}\geq 1.3$. Turning prediction uses a deep-water model.

Turning prediction sample ranges
Single-screw: $L_{\mathrm{pp}}=54.9\text{–}329.2\,\mathrm{m}$, $C_b=0.56\text{–}0.87$, $\delta=10^\circ\text{–}45^\circ$, $\frac{L}{B}=5.56\text{–}9.09$, $F_r=0.06\text{–}0.298$
Twin-screw: $L_{\mathrm{pp}}=76.2\text{–}225.6\,\mathrm{m}$, $C_b=0.42\text{–}0.62$, $\delta=10^\circ\text{–}35^\circ$, $\frac{L}{B}=5\text{–}16.67$, $F_r=0.074\text{–}0.655$

parameters.zh: TF、TA 为首尾吃水；LCG 从船中起以 %LWL 表示，向艏为正；舵作用点 XR 从船中起以 %LWL 表示，向艉为正。
parameters.en: TF and TA are forward and aft drafts. LCG is %LWL from amidships, positive forward; rudder force center XR is %LWL from amidships, positive aft.

parameters.zh: GYRAD 为艏摇回转半径与 LWL 的比值；AR=舵面积/(LWL·T)；H/T 为水深吃水比，原说明以 1000 表示深水。
parameters.en: GYRAD is yaw radius of gyration divided by LWL; AR=rudder area/(LWL·T); H/T is depth/draft ratio, with 1000 representing deep water in the inherited help.

results.zh: 线性评估给出 Nomoto 时间常数与增益、Clarke 回转指标、裸船体动稳定性和相位裕度；除相位裕度以 ° 表示外，原说明采用无量纲输出。
results.en: Linear evaluation gives Nomoto time constants/gains, Clarke turning index, bare-hull dynamic stability and phase margin. The inherited help uses nondimensional outputs except phase margin in °.

results.zh: 回转预估给出稳定回转直径、战术直径、进距、横距和回转中稳定航速。
results.en: Turning prediction gives steady turning diameter, tactical diameter, advance, transfer and steady turning speed.

sources.zh: M. G. Parsons, MPP-1.3, December 1994；Clarke, Gedling & Hine (RINA 124, 1982)；Lyster & Knights (NECIES 1978–1979)；Fugino (Michigan NAME Report 184, 1976)；Inoue, Hirano & Kijima (ISP 28(321), 1981)。
sources.en: M. G. Parsons, MPP-1.3, December 1994; Clarke, Gedling & Hine (RINA 124, 1982); Lyster & Knights (NECIES 1978–1979); Fugino (Michigan NAME Report 184, 1976); Inoue, Hirano & Kijima (ISP 28(321), 1981).

limits.zh: 船体表面不得与海底相交。
limits.en: The hull surface must not intersect the seabed.
